mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.iam_account account WHERE
mapper.sql: account.id, account.username, account.display_name, account.employee_number, account.organization_id, organization.name AS organization_name, account.status, account.validity_mode, account.effective_at, account.expires_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_org_owner owner WHERE owner.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND owner.organization_id = account.organization_id AND owner.account_id = account.id AND owner.is_deleted = false) AS owner, account.authz_version, account.created_time, account.version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.iam_account account JOIN public.iam_organization organization ON organization.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND organization.id = account.organization_id AND organization.is_deleted = false WHERE ORDER BY account.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM public.iam_account account JOIN public.iam_organization organization ON organization.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND organization.id = account.organization_id AND organization.is_deleted = false WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND account.id = #{accountId} AND account.is_deleted = false LIMIT 1

SELECT binding.account_id, role.id AS role_id, role.name AS role_name FROM public.iam_account_role binding JOIN public.iam_role role ON role.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND role.organization_id = binding.organization_id AND role.id = binding.role_id AND role.is_deleted = false WHERE binding.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND binding.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND binding.account_id IN #{accountId} AND binding.is_deleted = false ORDER BY binding.account_id, role.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.iam_username_registry WHERE normalized_username = #{normalizedUsername} AND is_deleted = false

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT role.id) FROM public.iam_role role WHERE role.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND role.id IN #{roleId} AND role.role_type = 'CUSTOM' AND role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role.is_deleted = false AND (#{rootOwner} = true OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_role_permission target_permission WHERE target_permission.tenant_id = role.tenant_id AND target_permission.organization_id = role.organization_id AND target_permission.role_id = role.id AND target_permission.is_deleted = false AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_account_role actor_binding JOIN public.iam_role actor_role ON actor_role.id = actor_binding.role_id AND actor_role.tenant_id = actor_binding.tenant_id AND actor_role.organization_id = actor_binding.organization_id AND actor_role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND actor_role.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_role_permission actor_permission ON actor_permission.tenant_id = actor_role.tenant_id AND actor_permission.organization_id = actor_role.organization_id AND actor_permission.role_id = actor_role.id AND actor_permission.is_deleted = false WHERE actor_binding.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND actor_binding.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND actor_binding.account_id = #{actorAccountId} AND actor_binding.is_deleted = false AND actor_permission.permission_id = target_permission.permission_id ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_role_data_policy policy WHERE policy.tenant_id = role.tenant_id AND policy.organization_id = role.organization_id AND policy.role_id = role.id AND policy.is_deleted = false AND policy.scope_type NOT IN ('SELF', 'CURRENT_ORG') ) ))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_account (id, tenant_id, organization_id, username, normalized_username, display_name, employee_number, status, validity_mode, effective_at, expires_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tenantId}, #{organizationId}, #{username}, #{normalizedUsername}, #{displayName}, #{employeeNumber}, 'PENDING_ACTIVATION', #{validityMode}, #{effectiveAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})

INSERT INTO public.iam_username_registry (normalized_username, subject_type, subject_id, original_username, login_enabled, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{normalizedUsername}, 'TENANT_ACCOUNT', #{accountId}, #{username}, true, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})

INSERT INTO public.iam_employee_number_registry (tenant_id, organization_id, normalized_employee_number, account_id, original_employee_number, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{organizationId}, #{normalizedEmployeeNumber}, #{accountId}, #{employeeNumber}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})

INSERT INTO public.iam_account_role (id, tenant_id, organization_id, account_id, role_id, assigned_by, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (nextval('public.iam_account_role_seq'), #{tenantId}, #{organizationId}, #{accountId}, #{roleId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})

INSERT INTO public.iam_outbox_event (id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, tenant_id, event_type, payload_json, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{outboxId}, #{eventId}, 'TENANT_ACCOUNT', CAST(#{accountId} AS varchar), #{tenantId}, 'ACCOUNT_PROVISION_REQUESTED', jsonb_build_object('accountId', CAST(#{accountId} AS varchar), 'tenantId', CAST(#{tenantId} AS varchar), 'organizationId', CAST(#{organizationId} AS varchar)), 'PENDING', #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHED', published_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{outboxId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_outbox_event SET status='RETRY', retry_count=retry_count+1, next_retry_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 minute', last_error_code=#{errorCode}, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{outboxId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_account SET authz_version=authz_version+1, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND id=#{accountId} AND version=#{version} AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED') AND is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_account_role SET is_deleted=true, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND account_id=#{accountId} AND is_deleted=false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_outbox_event (id,event_id,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,tenant_id,event_type, payload_json,status,created_by,updated_by) VALUES (#{outboxId},#{eventId},'TENANT_ACCOUNT',CAST(#{accountId} AS varchar),#{tenantId}, 'ACCOUNT_ROLES_CHANGED',jsonb_build_object('accountId',CAST(#{accountId} AS varchar), 'tenantId',CAST(#{tenantId} AS varchar), 'actionNameSnapshot','用户角色变化，强制会话失效', 'usernameSnapshot',(SELECT account.username FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.id=#{accountId}), 'displayNameSnapshot',(SELECT COALESCE(account.display_name, account.username) FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.id=#{accountId}), 'ipAddress',#{ipAddress}),'PENDING',#{operatorId},#{operatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_account SET display_name=#{displayName}, employee_number=#{employeeNumber}, validity_mode=#{validityMode}, effective_at=#{effectiveAt}, expires_at=#{expiresAt}, profile_version=profile_version+1, authz_version=authz_version + CASE WHEN #{authzChanged} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND id=#{accountId} AND version=#{version} AND status <> 'CANCELLED' AND is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_account SET status=#{targetStatus}, authz_version=authz_version+1, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND id=#{accountId} AND status=#{currentStatus} AND version=#{version} AND is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_username_registry SET login_enabled=false, disabled_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE subject_type='TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id=#{accountId} AND login_enabled=true AND is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_account SET username=#{username}, normalized_username=#{normalizedUsername}, profile_version=profile_version+1, authz_version=authz_version+1, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND id=#{accountId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND is_deleted=false
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.iam_account_role binding JOIN public.iam_role role ON role.tenant_id=binding.tenant_id AND role.organization_id=binding.organization_id AND role.id=binding.role_id AND role.role_type='CUSTOM' AND role.status='ACTIVE' AND role.is_deleted=false WHERE binding.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND binding.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND binding.account_id=#{accountId} AND binding.is_deleted=false

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT permission.id) FROM public.iam_account_role binding JOIN public.iam_role role ON role.tenant_id=binding.tenant_id AND role.organization_id=binding.organization_id AND role.id=binding.role_id AND role.status='ACTIVE' AND role.is_deleted=false JOIN public.iam_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.tenant_id=role.tenant_id AND role_permission.organization_id=role.organization_id AND role_permission.role_id=role.id AND role_permission.is_deleted=false JOIN public.iam_permission_resource permission ON permission.id=role_permission.permission_id AND permission.publish_status='PUBLISHED' AND permission.is_deleted=false WHERE binding.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND binding.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND binding.account_id=#{accountId} AND binding.is_deleted=false AND permission.permission_code IN ( 'iam:org-type:manage','iam:org:create','iam:org:update','iam:org:move','iam:org:status','iam:org:delete', 'iam:role:create','iam:role:update','iam:role:status','iam:role:delete','iam:role:grant','iam:role:data-scope', 'iam:user:create','iam:user:update','iam:user:status','iam:user:cancel','iam:user:role-assign','iam:user:password-reset' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_outbox_event (id,event_id,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,tenant_id,event_type, payload_json,status,created_by,updated_by) VALUES (#{outboxId},#{eventId},'TENANT_ACCOUNT',CAST(#{accountId} AS varchar),#{tenantId}, #{eventType},jsonb_build_object('accountId',CAST(#{accountId} AS varchar), 'tenantId',CAST(#{tenantId} AS varchar), 'actionNameSnapshot',#{actionNameSnapshot}, 'usernameSnapshot',(SELECT account.username FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.id=#{accountId}), 'displayNameSnapshot',(SELECT COALESCE(account.display_name, account.username) FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.id=#{accountId}), 'ipAddress',#{ipAddress}),'PENDING',#{operatorId},#{operatorId})
